dialog_history.content: I like to listen to people's problems. I am training to be a counsellor.  What would you like to talk about?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: That's a unique interest.  How much longer do you have before you are a counsellor?

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: About 12 minutes. Would you like to tell me what is on your mind at the moment?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Do you have any kids?

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: No I don't. I am here specifically to help you with problems that you might be facing at the moment. Do you have any problems at work, for instance?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I have a problem with finding work that doesn't need me to work on the weekend.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Ah I hear you there! Some employers are so inconsiderate; they expect us to drop everything and work at any time of any day.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I wouldn't mind it if I had local daycares that were opened on the weekend.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Ah, so I hear you saying that one of the things that you are struggling with is finding affordable childcare?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Isn't the affordable part but finding a daycare open on the weekend at all.  I don't want a private person. I would feel more comfortable with a daycare setting.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: What are your objections against a private person? Is it that you feel you could not trust them? Do you have any family members who could help?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I have no family that can help.  Yes, its me not trusting some random person.  In a daycare their cameras and others being around makes me feel more comfortable.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Could someone come to your home perhaps? You could set up your own cameras there. And you could make sure to get someone with excellent references

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I wouldn't even know where to begin to look.  Any suggestions?

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: You might be able to find good advice on local parenting forums. There must be other people there who are in the same situation.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Where would I find a local parenting forums?  I'm not very tech savy so I'm lost on all of that.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Try going to google, inputting your local area and searching for parenting advice forums :)

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: That sounds easy enough!  I never thought of this as being an option.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: I hope you are able to find someone who can set your mind at ease! Thank you for talking and have a wonderful festive season.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: You do the same!  Thanks for your advise and time :)

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: no worries :) remember to hit the button and  take the survey ;)

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Thanks for reminding me!

current_user_message: Thanks for reminding me!
supporter_response: I can't actually do it from my end until you do :)

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: I'm doing well, thank you! I'm sorry to hear that you're having a rough day. Do you mind me asking what happened to make you feel that way?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: My mother passed away about a month ago due to alcoholism, it has been rough attempting to cope with the many different emotions.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: I am so sorry to hear that. My brother suffers from alcoholism as well. I know how worrisome and difficult it can be. I still have a hard time dealing with my emotions. What different types of emotions are you feeling?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I'm so sorry that it's a situation that you can relate to, its such a hard situation watching someone drink their life away no matter what you do until they eventually pass away from it. I can say my anxiety has increased immensely as well as depression. It seems that quite a bit of pressure has been placed on me because of the family business she ran and my dad who is now trying to live without her.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Wow, that really is a lot to deal with. It seems as though you have a good understanding of what you're feeling but that you are trying to figure out how to move forward from here. It seems like you are trying to figure out how to work through your feelings as well as how to manage and deal with the pressure that has been put on you as a result. Does that sound accurate to you?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: It definitely does, I know it feels like quite a bit now but will gradually become easier to deal with.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: That is a great attitude to have. I'm very proud of you for trying to stay positive and for reassuring yourself that it will become easier for you to deal with over time. You sound like an incredibly strong person!

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Thank you so much! That means a lot just to hear and I think it is incredibly refreshing talking to someone that has a fresh mind about all of it rather than another family member that is attempting to cope with the same situation.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: You're very welcome! I know from experience that it is usually best and much easier to talk to someone on the outside who doesn't know all of the ins and outs of what you are experiencing.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: Have you considered any ways in which you could start to work through what you're feeling?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Very true, especially someone who is willing to listen and provide advice or positive conversation.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: Yes, I have begun a new medication that will hopefully help soon, I have also begun focusing on different hobbies that I enjoy so that I can keep my mind busy.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: It's great to hear that you are on a medication that will hopefully help you. Have you also considered speaking to an outpatient therapist or someone along those lines? That way, you could return to the same person as often as you feel necessary to continue to work through your feelings with someone who isn't directly involved with your situation.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: I think that focusing on different hobbies that you enjoy is an incredible way to take your mind off of everything and to keep yourself busy! What types of hobbies are you into?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I haven't thought too much about it, but I do think it might be a great time and something that will be necessary in order for self healing and really to just express the up and down emotions that occur.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I have recently fallen in love with wood working and different crafting. I enjoy being able to use my hands and become proud once i finish an accomplishment.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: I completely agree. I used to see a therapist. It was very difficult for me to do in the beginning, but once I got to know them, they provided me with coping strategies that otherwise, I never would have thought of. One of my favorites that he introduced me to was guided meditation. Have you ever heard of it?

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I have not, I think if i feel that I can open up quickly, it would be extremely beneficial.

dialog_history.speaker: supporter
dialog_history.content: That sounds awesome! You should look into a relatively new craft called diamond painting. I started doing them back in 2018 and it completely turns my brain off from the outside world.

dialog_history.speaker: seeker
dialog_history.content: I have been looking at them recently and think I might just order one! Thank you for the advice!

current_user_message: I have been looking at them recently and think I might just order one! Thank you for the advice!
